items.title: 52145_Andrew Blakeney oral history interview
items.q: The group was composed of Mr. Blakeney on trumpet; ... John Van Epps, piano; ... and this was done in 1961.

ctx.x: 1961, Hollywood, California, Mr. Blakeney recorded with the Kid Ory Orchestra an album entitled Kid Ory, Storyville Nights, Verve Label, 8456. This was a date in which they played all compositions of Jellyroll Martin.

The group was composed of Mr. Blakeney on trumpet; Johnny St. Cyr, Banjo; John Van Epps, piano; Bob McCracken, clarinet; the drummer was unknown; bass a Mr. Boyack (phonetic spelling), the first name unknown, and this was done in 1961.

1973, Crescent Productions presents the Legends of Jazz on the Legends of Jazz label, recorded in Minneapolis, Minnesota. The personnel included Andy Blakeney; Joe Darensbourg; Louis Nelson; Alton Purnell; Ed Montudie Garland; Barry Martyn, Drums.
